{{Top|leg}}
'''Agent T-238''' was a chemical that was designed to attack an individual's digestive tract, resulting in [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of severe and debilitating nausea.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> It was not fatal, unless used in large doses or if a target suffered repeated exposure.<ref name="MB">[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|''Star Wars Miniatures Battles'', First Edition]]</ref>

Agent T-238 could be deployed as a payload in [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] used grenades loaded with Agent T-238 in conjunction with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[T-238 grenade]]s were useful for crowd control and riot suppression.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
